The '''Tanjay system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tanjay IV]].
